gr-xendit-8032565003.d:
Xendit is an enterprise payments platform powering complex financial operations across Southeast Asia and global markets. We provide a unified API layer combining payment processing, global payouts, localized FX, identity compliance, and fraud protection. As a trusted financial partner backed by top-tier global investors, Xendit processes high-throughput transaction flows for leading global platforms including Meta, Traveloka, ByteDance, Wise, and Grab, building resilient payment infrastructure to drive regional commerce forward.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to drive the next generation of XenPlatform. XenPlatform is one of the most complex products in Xendit’s payment processing stack. Your main job will be to set its overall product direction and make sure we can serve marketplaces and platforms across all our regions.

Beyond long-term strategy, we need someone who can get into the weeds and break complex problems down for our engineering teams. You’ll bring payments experience, a track record of building global products at scale, and strong commercial judgement, so that what we build covers all our markets and scales sustainably.

You’ll have full ownership of your team’s strategy, priorities and outcomes, and the autonomy to define the next phase of XenPlatform.

What you’ll do in this role

• Drive the overall product strategy and roadmap, balancing competing stakeholder requests across teams and clearly communicating your prioritisation framework to senior leadership
• Deeply understand enterprise customers across segments (marketplaces, embedded finance and SaaS platforms), leveraging their feedback to define your longer-term roadmap
• Partner with Finance, Compliance, Legal and GTM to define the ideal customer profile (ICP) Xendit should focus on
• Design intuitive experiences across the API and the Xendit Dashboard, so merchants can clearly see how their platforms are performing and accurately reconcile their own data
• Build scalable account structures that accurately reflect how our enterprise merchants’ organisations are set up
• Partner with Engineering and Design to deliver products and features on time and to a high standard, making sure every XenPlatform feature is on par with or better than what’s in the market

What you’ll need in this role

• 5+ years of product management experience in fintech and/or B2B products
• Experience in payments processing (acquiring/issuing) or cross-border payouts
• Experience with onboarding and KYC/KYB flows
• A track record of driving roadmap and execution across cross-functional teams, owning north-star metrics such as TPV, conversion or retention
• Strong understanding of the technical, regulatory and operational challenges of building global financial products
• A clear, concise communication style that adapts to your audience
• Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to understand customer behaviour and make decisions
• Strong commercial acumen, with the judgement to balance commercial and product requirements

Job Description

• Deliver on-site technical solutions to boost shrimp farm productivity and profitability.
• Monitor water quality, feed programs, and shrimp health to identify performance improvement opportunities.
• Diagnose farm‑level challenges and provide actionable recommendations for corrective measures
• Build strong customer relationships through regular field visits and technical engagement
• Collaborate with the sales team to strengthen customer trust and support business growth.
• Prepare insightful reports on farm performance, customer feedback, and market conditions.

Qualification

• Bachelor of Aquaculture, Fisheries, or related field.
• 3-5years experience in shrimp farming or technical service.
• Strong technical expertise in shrimp culture and farm diagnostics.
• Fluent English with good technical communication skills.
• Strong customer handling and problem-solving skills.
• Field-oriented, highly adaptable.
• Willing to be placed at farm locations across all STP units in abroad and Indonesia.

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

• Memberikan solusi teknis langsung di lapangan untuk meningkatkan produktivitas dan profitabilitas tambak udang.
• Memantau kualitas air, program pemberian pakan, dan kesehatan udang untuk mengidentifikasi peluang peningkatan kinerja budidaya.
• Menganalisis permasalahan di tingkat tambak serta memberikan rekomendasi yang dapat diterapkan untuk tindakan perbaikan.
• Membangun hubungan yang kuat dengan pelanggan melalui kunjungan lapangan rutin dan pendampingan teknis.
• Berkolaborasi dengan tim penjualan untuk meningkatkan kepercayaan pelanggan dan mendukung pertumbuhan bisnis.
• Menyusun laporan yang informatif mengenai performa tambak, masukan pelanggan, dan kondisi pasar.

Kualifikasi

• Sarjana (S1) Budidaya Perairan, Perikanan, atau bidang terkait.
• Memiliki pengalaman 3-5 tahun di bidang budidaya udang atau layanan teknis (Technical Service).
• Memiliki pemahaman teknis yang kuat mengenai budidaya udang dan analisis/diagnosis permasalahan tambak.
• Mampu berbahasa Inggris dengan baik serta memiliki kemampuan komunikasi teknis yang efektif.
• Memiliki kemampuan yang baik dalam menangani pelanggan dan menyelesaikan masalah.
• Berorientasi pada pekerjaan lapangan serta memiliki kemampuan adaptasi yang tinggi.
• Bersedia ditempatkan di lokasi tambak pada seluruh unit STP di luar negeri maupun Indonesia

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Develop and maintain client relationships.
- Execute sales plan of actions as deployed from superior on monthly and quarterly basis (include plan of customer visit, expenses, sales target per outlet/customer, etc).

- Mengembangkan dan mempertahankan hubungan dengan klien.
- Melaksanakan rencana aksi penjualan yang diberikan oleh atasan secara bulanan dan triwulanan (termasuk rencana kunjungan pelanggan, pengeluaran, target penjualan per outlet/pelanggan, dll).
